verdict: Holistic, with a Claude classification model. Holistic with Claude Haiku 5.5 cost about the same as the default, Amazon Nova 2 Lite page by page ($470 against $493 per 1,000 packets), and got 0.80 of DocSplit sections exactly right, against 0.52. Holistic with Claude Sonnet 5 got 0.89 for about $200 more per 1,000 packets. With Amazon Nova 2 Lite, holistic barely helped (0.55). Detecting sections first added nothing over holistic with a Claude model and cost more.
